description: Eight rows contain all triples A, B, C from 000 to 111. Four columns show measured A AND B, then its carried AND C, and measured A OR B, then its carried OR C. All outputs match the Boolean targets at the tested phase-zero starts. Digits distinguish values without depending on color. This is a finite panel, not a general reliability estimate.

scope: Measured complete phase-zero input panels. Second gates use actual carried state. No inferred margins, universality or broader reliability.
uncertainty: No uncertainty intervals inferred; each execution bar is one recorded run and each logical cell is one measured panel output.
accessibility: Direct text labels and values; meanings do not rely only on color. PNG plots also have scalable SVG and PDF counterparts.
